citations.cites: Exclusion E-17 (burst or ruptured supply line) and its exception

facts: Insured found water under the vanity and a warped cabinet base. Not sure when the leak started, they rarely use that bathroom.
Plumber replaced a failed compression fitting on the supply line. The old fitting was thrown away by the plumber.
note: The notes do not establish whether the water discharge was "sudden and accidental" within 14 days, nor whether the leak persisted longer than 14 days (continuous seepage) [HO-0304_03-24#01]. The plumber discarded the failed fitting, which may void the exception to Exclusion E-17 that would otherwise preserve coverage, but the timing fact remains missing [HO-0304_03-24#06][HO-0304_03-24#05]. Additional information on the duration of the leak and retention of the failed component is required [HO-0304_03-24#05].
